edges: INS Aridhaman is the second boat in the Arihant class following INS Arihant.
INS Arihant set off for extensive sea trials in December 2014.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: INS Aridhaman is the second boat being prepared for sea trials after INS Arihant.
The Arihant class submarines are being built under the Advanced Technology Vessel project.
The Arihant is the first ballistic missile submarine built by India.
